title: festuca versicolor subsp. brachystachys
intro: Festuca versicolor subsp. brachystachys, commonly known as Blue Fescue, is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Blue Fescue include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily alkaloids and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
